title: Frontend Developer
summary: Builds the screens people use, in the browser.
description: Turns designs into fast, accessible web pages with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React.

title: Backend Developer
summary: Builds the APIs and data behind an app.
description: Designs REST APIs, authentication and databases, and keeps them fast and safe.

title: Data Analyst
description: Writes SQL, cleans data and turns it into dashboards and reports people act on.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Builds models that learn from data.
description: Prepares data, trains and evaluates models, and puts them into production.

title: AI Engineer
summary: Builds products on top of language models.
description: Designs prompts, retrieval and evaluation for features built on large language models.

title: Sales Development Representative
summary: Finds and books meetings with new customers.
description: Researches prospects, writes cold outreach and qualifies leads for the sales team.

title: Account Executive
summary: Turns qualified leads into signed customers.
description: Runs discovery, demos and negotiations, and forecasts the pipeline.

title: Digital Marketer
summary: Brings in and grows an audience online.
description: Plans campaigns and content across channels and measures what works.
